# Zoolyum

> Consultancy. Strategy. Solution. A strategy studio in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
> Brand positioning, digital design, and growth marketing for brands that
> want to be unmistakable.

Zoolyum runs every engagement through three acts: Consultancy (the read -
diagnosis before prescription), Strategy (the map - one defensible position),
Solution (the build - identity, interface, and campaign as one system).
